doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Dewey Corley's birth in Arkansas
summary: Corley was born 18 February 1898 in Halley, Arkansas; Allen asks if he knows pianist Joshua Altheim and Washboard Sam.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Oh, I see. Okay, well, let's get Dewey now. You can swap places with him, huh? Dewey? Yeah. Let's get your age, you know, when you were born?
February the 18th. Mm-hmm. And where were you born? Halley, Arkansas.
Halley. Where is that? How far from here?
Oh, about 200 miles or more. Oh,
from a good ways off. That's right. Ever know a guy named Joshua Altheim over there? Played piano, used to play with Washboard Sam a lot?
Oh, I've heard of him, I don't know of him.
I think he's from Altheim, Arkansas.
The same name is his. He's a fine piano player.
Well, you know who Washboard Sam is? You heard him on records, even if you didn't know him.
Oh, I've heard him on records.
